# Scraper
```{r}
school_names = c(
  "auburntigers"    = "Auburn",
  "floridagators"   = "Florida",
  "georgiadogs"     = "Georgia",
  "ukathletics"     = "Kentucky",
  "lsusports"       = "LSU",
  "olemisssports"   = "Ole Miss",
  "hailstate"       = "Mississippi State",
  "mutigers"        = "Missouri",
  "soonersports"    = "Oklahoma",
  "gamecocksonline" = "South Carolina",
  "utsports"        = "Tennessee",
  "texaslonghorns"  = "Texas",
  "12thman"         = "Texas A&M",
  "vucommodores"    = "Vanderbilt"
)

urls = c(
  "https://georgiadogs.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://hailstate.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://soonersports.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://olemisssports.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://texaslonghorns.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://utsports.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://floridagators.com/sports/football/roster"
  )

roster_function = function(roster_url){
  webpage = rvest::read_html(roster_url)
  
  # Get player cards first
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".s-person-card") -> cards
  
  # Names
  cards |> rvest::html_element("h3") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names
  
  # Position
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(1)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> position
  position = stringr::str_remove(position, "Position ")
  
  # Year
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(2)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> year
  year = stringr::str_remove(year, "Academic Year ")
  
  # Height
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(3)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> height
  height = stringr::str_remove(height, "Height ")
  
  # Weight
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-details__bio-stats-item:nth-child(4)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> weight
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, "Weight ")
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, " lbs")
  
  # Hometown
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-card__content__person__location-item") |> rvest::html_text2() -> hometown
  hometown = stringr::str_remove(hometown, "Hometown")
  split_home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
  city  = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 1])
  state = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 2])
  
  # Previous school
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".s-person-card__content__person__previous-school-item") |> rvest::html_text2() -> prev_school
  prev_school = stringr::str_squish(stringr::str_remove(prev_school, "^.*Previous School:"))
  
  # Current school
  site = stringr::str_extract(roster_url, "(?<=://)[^.]+")
  school = unname(school_names[site])
  
  # Make the data frame
  df = data.frame(school = school, name = names, year = year, position = position,
                  height = height, weight_lbs = weight,
                  hometown_city = city, hometown_state = state,
                  previous_school = prev_school)
  
  # Drop coach/staff cards (no listed position)
  df = df[!is.na(df$position), ]
  
  return(df)
}

sec_df = data.frame()
for (url in urls) {
  df = roster_function(roster_url = url)
  
  sec_df = rbind(sec_df, df)
  
  Sys.sleep(2)
}
```
```{r}
urls2 = c(
  "https://auburntigers.com/sports/football/roster",
  "https://mutigers.com/sports/football/roster?view=list",
  "https://12thman.com/sports/football/roster?view=list",
  "https://vucommodores.com/sports/football/roster?view=list",
  "https://lsusports.net/sports/fb/roster?view=list"
)

roster_function2 = function(roster_url){
  webpage = rvest::read_html(roster_url)
  
  # Get player cards first
  webpage |> rvest::html_elements(".roster-list-item") -> cards
  
  # Names
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-list-item__title") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names
  
  # Position
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--position") |> rvest::html_text2() -> position
  position = stringr::str_remove_all(position, "\\[|\\]")
  
  # Year
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--class-level") |> rvest::html_text2() -> year
  year = stringr::str_remove_all(year, "\\[|\\]")
  
  # Height
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--height > span") |> rvest::html_text2() -> height
  height = stringr::str_remove(height, "Height ")
  
  # Weight
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--weight") |> rvest::html_text2() -> weight
  weight = stringr::str_remove_all(weight, "\\[|\\]")
  weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, " lbs")
  
  # Hometown
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--hometown") |> rvest::html_text2() -> hometown
  hometown = stringr::str_remove(hometown, "Hometown")
  hometown = stringr::str_remove_all(hometown, "\\[|\\]")
  split_home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
  city  = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 1])
  state = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 2])
  
  # Previous school (NA for players who didn't transfer)
  cards |> rvest::html_element(".roster-player-list-profile-field--previous-school") |> rvest::html_text2() -> prev_school
  prev_school = stringr::str_remove_all(prev_school, "\\[|\\]")
  
  # Current school
  site = stringr::str_extract(roster_url, "(?<=://)[^.]+")
  school = unname(school_names[site])
  
  # Make the data frame
  df = data.frame(school = school, name = names, year = year, position = position,
                  height = height, weight_lbs = weight,
                  hometown_city = city, hometown_state = state,
                  previous_school = prev_school)
  
  # Drop coach/staff cards (no listed position)
  df = df[!is.na(df$position), ]
  
  return(df)
}

df = data.frame()
for (url in urls2) {
  df = roster_function2(roster_url = url)
  
  sec_df = rbind(sec_df, df)
  
  Sys.sleep(2)
}
```

# For University of Kentucky

uk_url = paste0("https://ukathletics.com/sports/football/roster/")
webpage = rvest::read_html(uk_url)

# Names
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(2) > a") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names

# Position
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(3)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> position
position = position[1:111]

# Year
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(6)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> year

# Height
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(4)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> height

# Weight
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(5)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> weight
weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, " lbs.")

# Hometown
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(7)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> hometown
split_home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
city  = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 1])
state = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 2])

# Previous school
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(9)") |> rvest::html_text2() -> prev_school
prev_school = stringr::str_squish(prev_school)

# Current school
school = "Kentucky"

# Make the data frame
df = data.frame(school = school, name = names, year = year, position = position,
                height = height, weight_lbs = weight,
                hometown_city = city, hometown_state = state,
                previous_school = prev_school)

sec_df = rbind(sec_df, df)

```{r}
# For University of South Carolina

south_carolina_url = paste0("https://gamecocksonline.com/sports/football/roster/")
webpage = rvest::read_html(south_carolina_url)

# Names
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("h3 > div > a") |> rvest::html_text2() -> names
names = names[1:112]

# Position
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("div > span.position") |> rvest::html_text2() -> position
position = position[1:112]

# Height, weight, and year all come from the same field
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("div > p.info") |> rvest::html_text2() -> info

split_info = stringr::str_split_fixed(info, "\\s*/\\s*", n = 3)

# Height
height = stringr::str_squish(split_info[, 1])

# Weight
weight = stringr::str_squish(split_info[, 2])
weight = stringr::str_remove(weight, " lbs")

# Year
year = stringr::str_squish(split_info[, 3])

# Hometown
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td.hometown") |> rvest::html_text2() -> hometown
split_home = stringr::str_split_fixed(hometown, ",", n = 2)
city  = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 1])
state = stringr::str_squish(split_home[, 2])

# Previous school
webpage |> rvest::html_elements("td.previousschool") |> rvest::html_text2() -> prev_school
prev_school = stringr::str_squish(prev_school)

# Current school
school = "South Carolina"

# Make the data frame
df = data.frame(school = school, name = names, year = year, position = position,
                height = height, weight_lbs = weight,
                hometown_city = city, hometown_state = state,
                previous_school = prev_school)

sec_df = rbind(sec_df, df)
```
